title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
summary: Following this week's midterms where voters resoundingly voiced their opposition to data center expansion, OpenAI today announced new commitments to communities where it is working on data center projects, including that it won't use non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with public o
reason: OpenAI's community commitments on NDAs for data center projects are company self-regulation, not a law, regulation, or government action (R4-1 excludes self-regulation), and not a model release, research artifact, OSS tool, or business deal event under R3-1.
